title: pteroceras fragrans
intro: Pteroceras fragrans, commonly known as the fragrant pteroceras, is a type of orchid species. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional African medicine. The health benefits of Pteroceras fragrans include its use in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its potential in lowering blood pressure and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant effects.
